name: Rock Howard
bio: The biological son of Geese Howard and protagonist of the game, has strong bonds with Terry Bogard, his adoptive father, and has had a huge opposition towards Geese since the death of his mother.
likes: The cap Terry gave him, his bike

name: Kim Dong Hwan
bio: The elder son of Kim Kaphwan, enters to the tournament to continue his father's legacy, although he doesn't take training too seriously.

name: Hotaru Futaba
bio: A girl daughter of martial artists, enters to the Maximum Mayhem for search her brother, in companion of her pet marten Itokatsu.

name: Marco Rodrigues
likes: His black belt and dojo sign
bio: A.K.A. Khushnood Butt, a Brazilian practitioner of the Kyokugenryu Karate and disciple of Ryo Sakazaki, enters to the Maximum Mayhem to prove the might of his martial art.

name: Hokutoramu
bio: A practitioner of the Shiranui-ryuu Ninjutsu and disciple of Andy Bogard, enters to the Maximum Mayhem at the request of his master.
likes: Hot springs, his master and all the Shiranui-ryuu people

name: Kevin Rian
bio: A S.W.A.T. policeman, enters to the tournament to take revenge on the man who killed his partner, in the company of his colleague's son, Marky.

name: Freeman
likes: His drill necklace, the edge of needles and blades
bio: A serial killer, who enters to the Maximum Mayhem to kill stronger opponents. One of his victims is Kevin Rian's police partner.

name: Tizoc
bio: A.K.A. The Griffon Mask, a famous pro wrestler, who has gained exceptional favoritism amongst all children audience.

name: B. Jenet
bio: The leader of the Lillien Knights, a group of pirates. She entered to the Maximum Mayhem to rob him of anything valuable that Kain R. Heinlein might be keeping in his mansion.
likes: Her comrades in the Lilien Knights, and state-of-the-art Lilien Knights weaponry

name: Gato
bio: A martial artist and criminal, who seeks revenge for the murder of his mother killed by his father.

name: Kim Jae Hoon
bio: The younger son of Kim Kaphwan, is very serious, diligent in his studies, and a charismatic man. He inherited from his father the strong sense of justice, and enters to the tournament to continue his legacy, like his elder brother.
likes: His family, small animals (rabbits, hamsters, ferrets, etc.)

name: Terry Bogard
likes: Keepsakes from his father, vintage jeans
bio: South Town's very own Legendary Hungry Wolf. Following his epic encounter with archrival Geese Howard, he takes young Rock (Geese's son) under his wing
